text_block_list.text:
"Called over by a phone call from Seiun 
Sky, I arrived at the designated meeting 
place to find—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! Congratulations. You have been 
chosen as the hero.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Now, you'll be taking on the 
challenge of helping Princess Sei-chan 
escape.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
As the brave hero, Trainer-san must safely 
rescue the princess from the Demon King.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Look, pay attention over there. A 
terrifying Demon King has her sights set 
on me, see?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Sky-saaan!! Please come out! My very 
fate is at stake here~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just for a moment! Just a teeny-tiny 
little bit! All you have to do is be mine 
and bring me some good luck, that's all 
I'm asking!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come on out, Sky-sa~n! No, Lady Sky! 
Please guide me to good fortune~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you hear? Fukukitaru-san actually 
intends to turn Sei-chan into a good luck 
charm!"
choice_data_list: Why would you do such a thing...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Apparently, that's what the fortune 
told her. Something like: "An easygoing, 
fluffy-looking girl who loves napping will 
bring you great fortune!"...
choice_data_list:
...Why don't you keep them company for a 
bit?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"What are you saying?! Just think about 
it! If incredible good fortune really 
comes from this—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lady Sky, praise be, praise be~! Please 
keep blessing me with your good fortune 
power!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lady Sky, you are truly a goddess of good 
fortune!! Please stay by my side as my 
second Lady Shiraoki for life—no, into the 
next life too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAH!? Help meee!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Might be how it turns out. No, that's 
definitely how it'll turn out. Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, am I destined to stay in 
Fukukitaru-san's room and just become 
another one of her lucky charms...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
They might make me sit in some cramped 
little shrine shelf, pose like a beckoning 
cat all day, and pray to me morning and 
night... Ugh, no way~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“—And that is why, Trai... no, Brave Hero! 
Please rescue me!”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple. Just give 
instructions on how Princess Sei-chan 
should run and escape from the Lucky Demon 
King!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, Brave Hero! Please! Let's join our 
forces and overcome this crisis together!
choice_data_list: Maybe I should try to bait them...
Let's go with a "Front Runner" strategy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho, sounds like a trick Sei-chan would 
love. ...So what's the plan, specifically?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ohohoho~~~?

"And so, we held a strategy meeting right 
then and there, solidifying our plan to 
safely escape."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, our strategy is foolproof... 
hopefully. Well, shall we go?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!! There it is, my Great Blessing!! 
Sky-saaaaaaaan!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Uhee...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's no use... They caught up to 
me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew, good fortune is finally in my 
hands...! Now then, Sky-san! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeees... Geez, even Sei-chan has to throw 
in the towel and—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —There isn't one! Boom!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? Good fortune is slipping right 
through my fingers...!? W-Wait for me, 
Sky-saaann!!

Taking advantage of Matikane Fukukitaru 
letting her guard down, Seiun Sky 
accelerated at full throttle and 
successfully made her escape.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Tadaaa. Game clear. Thank you for saving 
me from the Demon King of Good Fortune.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, you're quite ruthless for a 
hero~. I was startled when you told me to 
get captured on purpose."
choice_data_list: Still, you believed in me, didn't you?
Still, you believed in me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, come on, you're exaggerating. 
Sei-chan was just playing strictly by the 
rules.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Princess Sei-chan pulled off even the 
Hero's absurd requests. Good girl, good 
girl. Yes, yes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's also because I had 
complete faith that you'd clear it 
properly. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's easy to understand... which is 
great and all, but isn't it a bit *too* 
simple?
choice_data_list: Make the most of your strengths.

You need to make the absolute most of your 
strengths.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Oho, I see. Could you tell me more 
about that in detail?"

Through a quick strategy meeting, we 
devised a plan to make full use of Seiun 
Sky's strengths. And then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! Well then, how about I pull 
off a massive breakaway!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! Found it... wait, it's so fast!? Wait 
for me~~!! My Great Fortune~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, come on! If you don't 
hurry, Sei-chan the lucky charm is gonna 
get away~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, I won't let you get away~!! I'm 
coming to get you right now!! Hang on, 
Daikichi~!!

Afterward, Matikanefukukitaru showed the 
momentum to catch up to Seiun Sky, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, what incredible speed... but still! 
Is it really okay to go that fast~?

...In the end, Matikanefukukitaru's pace 
was thrown off, allowing Seiun Sky to 
successfully run away with the lead.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da-da-daaa. Game clear. ...Looks like 
the strategy worked out nicely~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, going out of your way to provoke 
them. Are you perhaps the type who can't 
enjoy games unless you impose challenge 
restrictions on yourself?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, it seems that threw off 
Fukukitaru-san's pace, though.
choice_data_list: It went exactly as planned, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe. After all, this is a surefire 
winning strategy for us.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. Clearing the game grants EXP 
to Sei-chan's specialty~. Whooooosh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Tada-da-daan~♪ Sei-chan leveled up! 
...is what it feels like~. Hehe."
